newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebels in Lubumbashi centre, Belgian wounded.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels in Lubumbashi centre, Belgian wounded.

text.p: Laurent Kabila's rebels entered the centre of Zaire's second biggest city Lubumbashi on Wednesday evening, but gunfire could still be heard and the Zairean army was reported still in control of the airport six km (four miles) to the north, witnesses said.
In the fighting one Belgian national, a longtime resident of the city, was critically wounded by a mortar shell exploding in his garden. He was undergoing surgery.

Kabila's rebels had entered Lubumbashi's southern suburbs from the direction of the Zambian border earlier on Wednesday. Residents said rebels had fought heavy street battles against President Mobutu Sese Seko's Special Presidential Division.
Expatriate sources said that senior army officers and perhaps several hundred soldiers were holding out at the airport when a plane arrived in the early evening.

The sources feared the army did not have enough fuel or planes to evacuate its people from the airport. There was no obvious way out of the airport and it was widely expected that fierce fighting would break out there.
"Perhaps they have nowhere to go," said one Western source.
